environment: STAGING isolated fictitious PostgreSQL; DML-only service role

cases.name: TC01: 4-tier chain definition (Cohamy -> A1 -> A2 -> S -> End Customer)
TC02: Direct short routes (Cohamy -> A1 -> Store Direct)
TC03: Independence of partner_type and pricing_tier
TC04: Warehouse is not a dealer level; warehouse user cannot manage relations
TC05: Multiple user accounts per organization with individual audit trail
TC06: Distribution relation records upstream, downstream, status, starts_at, created_by
TC07: Prevent self-parenting
TC08: Prevent cycles in distribution hierarchy
TC09: Prevent attaching branch to its own descendant
TC10: Changing distribution relations never rewrites previously confirmed orders
TC11: Sibling dealer isolation (Dealer B cannot view Dealer A branch requests)
TC12: Descendant visibility (Dealer A1 can see A2 and Store S)
TC13: Store S cannot see parent Dealer A1 or sibling store data
TC14: Central Admin can see all branches and orders
TC15: Warehouse scope isolation
TC16: Direct ID access rejection for out-of-scope entity
TC17: Global search respects scope
TC18: Scoped counts and dashboards do not leak sibling metrics
TC19: Commercial timeline for Dealer A is inaccessible by Dealer B
TC20: Sales rep reassignment preserves legal seller and buyer
TC21: Self-service onboarding creates applicant with PENDING review
TC22: Admin approval assigns partnerType, parentOrganizationId, pricingTierId, creditEnabled, creditLimit
TC23: Approval atomically creates active distribution relation to parent
TC24: Approval creates credit account when creditEnabled is true
TC25: Application rejection creates no distribution relation or credit account
TC26: Self-onboarding cannot set partner_type directly without admin review
TC27: Idempotency of onboarding approval
TC28: Onboarding audit log records reviewer admin ID and timestamp
TC29: Non-admin users cannot approve onboarding applications
TC30: Approved partner can log in and view assigned parent
TC31: Layer A (Product promotion) discount applied first (100k -> 90k)
TC32: Layer B (FIXED_PERCENT) applies to remaining base: 90k * 70% = 63k, 90k * 60% = 54k
TC33: Layer B (QUANTITY_TIER) half-open intervals [min, max)
TC34: Aggregation across multiple lines of same SKU before tier matching
TC35: Line falling below minimum tier gets 0% Layer B discount
TC36: Exact lower boundary [min, ...) receives tier discount
TC37: Exact upper boundary transitions to next tier
TC38: Sequential calculation is exact without IEEE 754 precision loss
TC39: Price snapshot frozen in version; future promo change does not affect snapshot
TC40: Stale price detection on re-save recalculates against published price
TC41: Store S submits commercial request to Tier 2 Dealer A2
TC42: Dealer A2 approves Store S request
TC43: Dealer A2 escalates shortage upstream to Tier 1 Dealer A1
TC44: Dealer A1 approves Dealer A2 request
TC45: Dealer A1 escalates upstream to Cohamy factory
TC46: Each tier maintains independent pricing snapshot
TC47: Route chain traceability from Store S to Cohamy
TC48: Downstream cannot confirm order against upstream without upstream approval
TC49: Internal departments of same legal entity do not generate cross-entity POs
TC50: Canceling downstream order does not automatically cancel upstream order
TC51: Order confirmation creates stock reservation, not physical deduction
TC52: Physical deduction occurs only on dispatch / fulfillment shipment confirmation
TC53: Insufficient stock with allowPartial: false rejects reservation
TC54: Insufficient stock with allowPartial: true reserves available amount
TC55: Shortage of 24 recorded in backorder with expected_on: NULL (no fake delivery dates)
TC56: Fulfillment shortage details recorded on sales order
TC57: Subsequent stock intake allows fulfilling remaining backorder
TC58: Order cancellation releases reserved stock back to available pool
TC59: Warehouse staff assigned to Warehouse A cannot dispatch stock from Warehouse B
TC60: Stock balance invariants: on_hand = available + reserved holds consistently
TC61: Creditor organization is the seller (creditor_organization_id = seller_organization_id)
TC62: Store S receivable is owed to Dealer A2, NOT directly to Cohamy
TC63: Dealer A2 receivable is owed to Dealer A1
TC64: Dealer A1 receivable is owed to Cohamy
TC65: Debt posted only upon delivery confirmation; unconfirmed order cannot post receivable
TC66: Credit limit check blocks orders exceeding approved credit limit
TC67: Multi-order payment allocation across multiple receivables
TC68: Allocation amount cannot exceed payment amount or remaining receivable balance
TC69: Fully allocated receivables update status to PAID
TC70: Dealer owner can view their own debtors and payment allocations
TC71: Article draft in CRM is private (isPublicBlogRow === false, hidden from public)
TC72: Publishing article makes it public (isPublicBlogRow === true); unpublishing reverts to draft
